// Source of the android-report.json / android-mapping.txt fixtures. Kept as
// .txt so no Kotlin tool compiles it. To regenerate: kotlinc this file with
// the hooks PyreonCrashReporter.kt and runtime-kotlin PyreonStorageBackends.kt +
// PyreonJson.kt (plus a two-name androidx.compose.runtime stub: MutableState,
// mutableStateOf) against kotlinx-serialization-json; minify with R8
// (r8.jar --classfile --release, -keep ProofAppKt.main); run it with a crash
// directory. The persisted report is android-report.json and the R8 mapping is
// android-mapping.txt. The retrace assertions name this file's line numbers,
// counted from the package line below as line 1.
package com.example.shop

import com.pyreon.runtime.FileStorageBackend
import com.pyreon.runtime.PyreonCrashBuildInfo
import com.pyreon.runtime.PyreonCrashReporter
import java.io.File

class CheckoutService {
    fun applyDiscount(code: String): Int {
        val table = mapOf("WELCOME" to 5)
        return table[code] ?: rejectCode(code)
    }

    private fun rejectCode(code: String): Int {
        throw IllegalStateException("discount code rejected: $code")
    }
}

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    val reporter = PyreonCrashReporter(
        FileStorageBackend(File(args[0])),
        PyreonCrashBuildInfo(appId = "com.example.shop", version = "1.4.0", buildNumber = "42"),
    )
    reporter.start()
    reporter.breadcrumb("opened checkout")
    CheckoutService().applyDiscount("SAVE10")
}
